target.name: Charmed
target.description: You cannot attack or use harmful effects against the charmer, who has advantage on social checks involving you.

target.name: Frightened
target.description: While you can see the source of your fear, your attacks and ability checks have disadvantage. You cannot willingly move closer to it.

target.name: Grappled
target.description: Your speed becomes 0. The grapple ends if you are moved out of the grappler’s reach.

target.name: Paralyzed
target.description: You cannot act, move, or speak, and nearby attacks that hit you are critical hits.

target.name: Petrified
target.description: You turn into a solid, inanimate substance and cannot act or move. You have resistance to all damage.

target.name: Prone
target.description: You can crawl or stand up. Your attacks have disadvantage, and nearby attackers have advantage against you.

target.name: Restrained
target.description: Your speed is 0. Your attacks and Dexterity saves have disadvantage, and attacks against you have advantage.

target.name: Stunned
target.description: You cannot act and automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves. Attackers have advantage against you.

target.name: Advantage
target.description: Roll two d20s and use the higher roll.

Talongrip Coast

sections.title: Appearance
lines: An immense reptile with a body that resembles both a snake and an eel.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Bite · Melee Weapon Attack · +8 to hit · reach 20 ft. · 3d6 + 5 piercing
Tail · Melee Weapon Attack · +8 to hit · reach 25 ft. · 3d8 + 5 bludgeoning

sections.title: Traits mechanics
lines: Hold Breath · Can hold its breath for 1 hour.

sections.title: Actions mechanics
lines: Multiattack · 2 attacks · One bite and one tail attack, or two bite attacks.

Bite · +8 to hit · reach 20 ft. · One target takes 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage on a hit and is grappled on a failed save (escape DC 16). The wakewyrm can grapple only one creature and cannot bite a different creature while that grapple lasts. · DC 16 Strength · 3d6 + 5 piercing
Tail · +8 to hit · reach 25 ft. · One target takes 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage on a hit. · 3d8 + 5 bludgeoning

Swallow · The wakewyrm bites a Large or smaller creature it has grappled. On a hit the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is blinded, restrained, and has total cover from outside effects. At the start of each wakewyrm turn it takes 11 (3d6) acid damage. If the wakewyrm takes 18 or more damage from a creature inside it, it must make the save at the end of that turn or expel every swallowed creature prone within 10 ft. On death, swallowed creatures are freed from restraint and can leave the corpse by spending 20 ft. of movement. · DC 15 Constitution · 3d6 acid

sections.title: Table notes
lines: After death, the body floats for several hours before sinking.
Hit Point Press, Humblewood Campaign Setting v1.04, Appendix A, p. 189.
